title: Just finished my demo after 3 months of excessive vibe coding
author: netplay-ent
selftext: Hi guys, I'm currently working on a medieval RPG / Simulation dynasty game and just released the demo today. I have high ambition for this game, as it shall be a mashup of the guild, crusader kings and game of thrones. Would love to get your feedback: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4895130/Medieval\_Ascendant\_\_Prologue/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4895130/Medieval_Ascendant__Prologue/)

comments.author: ChickenTheGreneral
comments.body: The idea is really good. I was curious as a dev. How do you handle marketing on reddit?

replies.author: netplay-ent
replies.body: Thank you. I'm in the privileged position to already run a successful business, so I got some cash for marketing. To share some of my experience with you: In the first week of promotion I have paid 0.40€ per wishlist. This became worse as days passed to a current value of 3€/wishlist. So I would recommend, if cash is tight, run a campaign in the week of steam next fest or release to push the algorithm.
